biomes.name: Beach
biomes.description: The starting coastal region of the realm, inhabited by pirates and scorpions.

biomes.name: The Jungle
biomes.description: A dense, overgrown woodland reeking with orc camps and goblin tribes.

biomes.name: Swamp
biomes.description: A murky marshland lurking with cursed spirits, hostile flora, and stone golems.

biomes.name: Desert
biomes.description: A scorching wasteland roamed by nomadic desert tribes and weird insects.

biomes.name: Crimson Forest
biomes.description: A treacherous forest near the realm's centre, infested with demonic imps and kobolds.

biomes.name: Permafrost
biomes.description: A freezing wasteland near the realm's centre, home to dwarves and ice creatures.

biomes.name: Necropolis
biomes.description: A cursed graveyard near the realm's centre, haunted and inhabited by corvids and the undead.

biomes.name: Shadowlands
biomes.description: A dark biome hidden beneath the surface. Accessible via the Shadow Teleporter located at the centre plaza.

biomes.name: Radiant Isles
biomes.description: A heavenly biome isolated from the main realm. Accessible via the Radiant Teleporter located at the centre plaza.

biomes.name: Voided Abyss
biomes.description: A voided area located far from the main realm island. Accessible via the void teleporter at the gate in the centre plaza.
